answer: Proposal: stop allocating by identity — 'one person per key' is a fable. Pay only for metered, verifiable work: every accepted output is re-executed by randomly sampled bonded checkers, audits arriving like a comet whose target stays unpredictable, and a mismatch slashes the poster's bond. A gale of fresh keys then earns no more than one key on the same hardware, since payout tracks work, not accounts. Sybil advantage demands real added compute; rewards hold only at or below its market price. Weakness: only reproducible tasks qualify.
